name: windows-sandbox-computer-use
description: Control and debug Windows Sandbox through wsb and IronRDP without automating local windows.

interface.shortDescription: Visually control and share files with Windows Sandbox
interface.longDescription: Create, inspect, share scoped directories with, and visually control an authorized Windows Sandbox using the current wsb CLI and IronRDP Agent.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this Windows Sandbox is ready for visual control.
Share a debug directory read-only with this Windows Sandbox.
Control this Windows Sandbox and verify each action visually.
